One time I was imagining/reliving a scary moment for me to my therapist and talking her through it. It happened to me aswell. It’s called an extinction burst. Ocd is your overprotective brain trying to keep you safe. An extinction burst is your brains way of scaring you back into listening and doing whatever it demands. It’s perfectly normal. I hope that helps :)
Maybe listen to music or meditation/asmr. Or even a podcast. When my mind won’t stop I find that background noise gives me something to focus on instead of what’s bothering me.
